content: OpenVPN reliable.c implements the control-channel reliability layer: bounded array of reliable_entry slots per session, exponential backoff retransmission (timeout *= 2), ACK-count based fast-retransmit (n_acks >= N_ACK_RETRANSMIT triggers resend before timeout), packet-id window/wraparound handling via reliable_pid_in_range1/2. No stdlib equivalent; must be hand-built as the engine behind the custom net.Conn framing layer.
